acquisition_vs_composition: Full original publisher figures, PDFs/methods and first crop checks were acquired separately and remain private. Public composer needs only these immutable derived image inputs and records; it does not download sources or re-crop the private full figures.
source_credits_checked: Primary article rights and figure captions checked; no third-party exclusions found for these figures.

sources.modifications: Exact rectangular crop only; source labels and calibration bars retained. No resampling, enhancement or colour change.
sources.specimen: Postmortem human organ-donor brachial artery (panel A) and basilic vein (panel B); representative donor identities not supplied. Cohort includes hypertension/diabetes; not classified globally normal.
sources.preparation: 10% neutral formalin fixation; paraffin embedding/sectioning; Movat pentachrome. 5 mm is sampled cross-section length, not microscopic section thickness (unreported).
sources.source_label_limit: A panel has printed L/M/A, no separately resolved printed I; B panel has I/L/M/A. Caption defines intima but no new arterial intima leader is supplied.
sources.purpose: Partial-wall organisation and source-stained tissue comparison; not complete lumen geometry or mechanical response.
